about_the_game:
VizuL is an urban fantasy wherein the in-universe magic system integrates to the gameplay. for players who are insecure with bullet hell mechanics, there's a Story mode in which boss battles are choice-based.

Mirtilo is a very troubled girl. She left her home behind to search for her missing parents. That same morning, moments later, her cousin Garoa pays her beloved relatives a visit to find them missing almost without a trace! No one is around and there's some evil entity out there.

Come along this whimsical, colorful adventure with the two cousins seeking answers at their own pace.

Features in this demo:

  • up to three stages with four bosses total and a miniboss

  • bullet hell mechanics, primarily on boss fights

  • an accessibility tool on boss battles that can be accessed when pausing

  • 5 difficulty modes: Story, Easy, Regular, Hard and Ultimate

  • English interface, single-player, 2 girls as playable characters, with different stats, abilities and dialog for their respective scenarios

  • each boss attack is a checkpoint, meaning you respawn onto the attack you died to

  • a bonus, hidden area that can be accessed on Hard and Ultimate difficulties, that awards the player upon clearing it (with even more use to this reward on the full game)

TROUBLESHOOTING:

  • if you start the game and somehow it's not playing the sound effects, restart the game.

  • there's a rare bug that comes with RPG Maker 2003, in which the controls do not work at all when you open the game. if you come across it, rebooting the computer should do the trick

content_descriptors.notes: this demo is rated R-15 for foul language, violence and themes related to abuse and racism. though it's much tamer than the envisioned full version, consult the README.txt file for details.
